resources.string: Built for television viewing and a standard remote.
This is a UI preview. There is no VPN engine yet; network traffic is not protected by this app.
Independent Android TV launcher, D-pad navigation, visible focus and Android Back.
Independent ARM32 VPN engine, server imports and verification of real traffic routes.
VPN profiles are not supported yet. Server selection and verified connection state will appear once the VPN engine exists.
Per-app routing modes will follow device validation of Android VPN behavior.
Secure phone-assisted profile transfer is being designed. Real links and credentials cannot be added in this preview.
Vitrum TV is an independent app. Neither mobile Vitrum nor tablet-oriented Vitrum Lite is changed.
Arrows — Navigate OK — Select Back — Return
